title: Labor, PPE, Debris Load and Minimum Charge Rates for Mold Remediation
content:
Mold Remediation labor is priced per hour at business-hours rates, PPE per technician per day, bagged debris per pickup-truck load, and every job is subject to a minimum job charge. Tier values:

| Item | Spot | Limited | Standard | Extensive | Attic and Crawlspace | HVAC System |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Technician hourly rate, business hours (USD) | 84.25 | 84.25 | 84.25 | 80.05 | 88.40 | 91.75 |
| Supervisor hourly rate, business hours (USD) | 102.80 | 102.80 | 102.80 | 97.65 | 106.90 | 109.50 |
| After-hours labor multiplier | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 |
| PPE, per technician per day (USD) | 24.60 | 46.20 | 46.20 | 46.20 | 52.80 | 46.20 |
| Minimum respiratory protection | N95 | Half-face P100 | Half-face P100 | Full-face P100 | Full-face P100 | Half-face P100 |
| Debris disposal fee per load (USD) | 214.00 | 214.00 | 214.00 | 192.60 | 238.00 | 214.00 |
| Minimum job charge (USD) | 395.00 | 750.00 | 1250.00 | 2500.00 | 1450.00 | 1150.00 |

## Definitions

- **Technician hourly rate / supervisor hourly rate**: remediation technician labor and remediation supervisor labor per hour, at the business-hours rate.
- **After-hours labor multiplier**: the multiplier on hourly labor rates for labor the customer asks to have performed in the after-hours window. It is 1.5 on every tier.
- **PPE**: respirator, suit and glove PPE per technician per day. The minimum respiratory protection row gives the lowest respirator class technicians use on the tier: N95, half-face P100 or full-face P100.
- **Debris disposal fee per load**: bagged debris haul-off per pickup-truck load.
- **Minimum job charge**: the smallest total of remediation scope, equipment and clearance charges billed on a job; a shortfall is billed as a minimum charge line.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- An after-hours technician hour on a tier whose technician rate is 91.75 is billed at 91.75 multiplied by 1.5, which is 137.625 and rounds half up to 137.63.
- A job on a tier with a minimum job charge of 1150.00 whose remediation scope, equipment and clearance charges total 1040.00 falls short by 110.00, which is the shortfall billed as the minimum charge line.
